name: P7_SPLIT4_LEMMA11_ACCEPTABILITY_FRAGMENT_GATE_V1

primary_source_binding.paper: Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs. II. Finding an Excellent Precoloring
literal_sequence: Property (5): if y in descendant Y' has a neighbor in descendant Y0', then y belongs to old Y.
For an acceptability violation, choose nonadjacent y,y' in N(Y0') intersect Y' with different lists and a common extension-color condition.
Choose z,z' in descendant Y0' adjacent respectively to y,y'.
Use Lemma 5/property (5) provenance to recover y,y' in old Y and equality of old/new lists.
Let T=T(y), T'=T(y'); prove T intersect T'=empty.
Use nonemptiness of the relevant descendant-Y intersections to infer |V(Q_{T,T'})|>1.
In the legacy 000/001/111 language, |V(Q)|>1 forces the 111 triple (p,m,n).
Use descendant axiom (v), stability/color facts and anticompleteness of z to the enlarged seed.
Construct induced P6 z-y-s-p-m-n and contradict P6-freeness.

scope: Static proof-fragment replay and complete escape-mode classification after the transferred Lemma 5/6/7/10 chain. No repair, no graph-family search, no Break-B construction.
target: For every generated descendant P' in the authoritative core, determine whether the printed acceptability proof transfers. If not, classify the first exact escape mode; do not repair it.

E0_BIND_DESCENDANT_PROVENANCE.obligation: Bind each descendant P' produced through lifted Lemma 10 to its normalized raw ancestor (Qhat,f') and preserve the local state Qhat_{T,T'} needed by the acceptability proof.

witness: nonadjacent y,y' in Y' intersect N(Y0')
c(y),c(y') both lie in L_{P'}(y) intersect L_{P'}(y')
E1_ASSUME_ACCEPTABILITY_VIOLATION.role: Assumption for contradiction/classification, not an existence claim.

obligations: choose residual attachments in Y0' for y and y'
derive old/new list equality for y,y'
set T=T_P(y), T'=T_P(y') in the original P
derive T intersect T'=empty from the acceptability-violation color/list conditions exactly as in the source proof
verify (T,T') belongs to the relevant ordered type-pair set

COMMON.definition: There exists z in Y0' adjacent to both y and y'.
COMMON.note: This is the role played by the Lemma-4 collapse in the printed P6-free proof.

SPLIT.definition: No common Y0' neighbor exists. Choose zL in N(y) intersect Y0' and zR in N(y') intersect Y0'.
required_derivations: zL-zR is a nonedge from descendant axiom (iv), since otherwise y or y' is mixed on a Y0' edge
zL,zR belong to old Y0 by the descendant/source provenance
replay verified P7_CORRIDOR_RIGIDITY on old types T,T' to obtain an exact induced P6 residual corridor

E4_RESIDUAL_ATTACHMENT_CLASSIFICATION.exhaustiveness_obligation: Because y,y' both lie in N(Y0'), exactly COMMON or SPLIT applies.

E5_STORED_STATE_CLASSIFICATION.obligation: Re-prove, in the extended 000/001/111/SPLIT4 language, which raw local modes Qhat_{T,T'} can coexist with the descendant acceptability-violation configuration.
E5_STORED_STATE_CLASSIFICATION.mandatory_subclaim: Do not reuse the legacy inference |V(Q)|>1 => 111. First prove or falsify ACCEPTABILITY_ESCAPE => Qhat_{T,T'} in {111,SPLIT4}.
E5_STORED_STATE_CLASSIFICATION.source_001_firewall: If 001 cannot be eliminated without choosing between the conflicting source selectors, return/source-quarantine that dependency rather than resolving it by convention.

obligation_per_cell: determine reachability under all frozen hypotheses
if unreachable, give the exact contradiction before any new repair
if reachable, determine whether existing frozen hypotheses alone imply acceptability
if they do not, return a decorated P7-free acceptability-escape specification/witness obligation and the first source inference that no longer follows

cross_cutting_facts_to_verify_not_assume: A descendant Y0' attachment is anticomplete to the descendant enlarged seed by descendant axiom (iii); therefore it is anticomplete to stored support vertices that remain in the seed.
Property (5) provenance is sufficient to interpret y,y' by original types T,T'.
The transferred Lemma-10 output supplies the descendant axioms used in residual SPLIT classification.
For stored SPLIT4, absence of a middle m makes the literal legacy CZ004 path syntactically unavailable; this fact alone is not a contradiction or repair.

source_fork_being_audited.extended_language: |V(Qhat_{T,T'})|>1 permits 111 or SPLIT4 (and E5 must independently eliminate any other surviving configuration).
source_fork_being_audited.consequence: The line introducing P={p}, M={m}, N={n} is no longer automatically licensed after the extended-language replacement.

pass.label: PASS_P7_ACCEPTABILITY_FRAGMENT_AUTHORITATIVE_CORE
pass.condition: E0-E5 pass and every authoritative-core reachable E6 cell is either unreachable or closed using frozen hypotheses only.

fail.label: FAIL_P7_ACCEPTABILITY_ESCAPE
required_fields: cell C11|C1S|CS1|CSS or pre-matrix stage E0-E5
first line of the printed proof that no longer follows

next_action: Perform the static E0-E6 proof audit only after explicit authorization or continue source analysis; no repair is auto-authorized.
